text: a Benjamite: Or, the son of a man of Jemini | power: Or, substance
is spent in: Heb. is gone out of etc. | have we?: Heb. is with us?
Behold I have here at hand: Heb. there is found in my hand
Well said: Heb. Thy word is good
the hill to the city: Heb. in the ascent of the city
about this time: Heb. to day
told Samuel in his ear: Heb. revealed the ear of Samuel
three days ago: Heb. today three days
so to me?: Heb. according to this word?
